answer: Make admission a cross-domain handoff. The applicant first completes a priced, reproducible task for community A and locks the fee in escrow. A settlement bridge then carries only the digest and fee receipt into community B, which must have an empty recent co-signature overlap with A. Community B holds a brief summit, recomputes the digest independently, and either releases or slashes the escrow. A delayed river of two epochs keeps released stake non-transferable to any new name. Cloning identities therefore requires capital and two unaffiliated reviewer graphs, not just extra keys.
